extraction.document_summary: Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II is a critical illness insurance plan that provides multiple payouts across early, intermediate, and severe stage critical illnesses. It covers “135 conditions” with continued protection after diagnosis, including recurrence. Under the Critical Illness Benefit, an early/intermediate stage diagnosis pays 100% of your sum assured per eligible claim (up to 2 claims and up to 300% total under the Recurrent Illness Benefit section’s limits described), while specified severe stage diagnoses pay 100% of sum assured and can be repeated within defined group rules, subject to a total cap. The plan can reach a maximum total payout of “900% of the Sum Assured.” Upon your first severe stage diagnosis, premiums are waived and an Advance Care Option may be exercised to receive an additional “75% of the Sum Assured” in one lump sum; this option ends the Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit. A separate death benefit of S$5,000 applies if death occurs during the coverage period. Coverage terms can be chosen “from 10 years up to age 99 (in one-year intervals)” and benefits can be paid in SGD, USD, GBP, EUR, AUD or HKD.

aliases: Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II (Critical Illness Benefit, Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit, Advance Care Option)
policies.quick_summary: Multi-stage (early/intermediate/severe) critical illness coverage with multiple payouts and a recurrence feature, plus premium waiver on first severe stage diagnosis. Also includes optional Advance Care Option that converts Recurrent protection into an extra lump-sum payout, and a small death benefit of S$5,000 during coverage. Maximum total payout stated as up to 900% of sum assured, subject to benefit cessation rules and waiting/survival periods described in the brochure notes and sections shown in the text and tables/figures excerpted here (full illness lists and definitions are in the Product Summary).
coverage_scope: Early stage critical illnesses (100% sum assured per eligible claim, per CI Group)
Intermediate stage critical illnesses (100% sum assured per eligible claim, per CI Group)
Severe stage critical illnesses (100% sum assured per eligible claim, per CI Group)
Recurrent critical illnesses (additional payouts for recurrences of specified severe conditions and their recurrences)
Special Benefits on top of main critical illness coverage (extra cushioning for special conditions, including a borderline/benign tumour surgical removal and ICU stay of 4 days or more as described)
Premium waiver upon first severe stage critical illness diagnosis under the Critical Illness Benefit
Advance Care Option to receive an additional lump-sum payout from eligible severe stage diagnosis (terminates Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit if exercised)
Death benefit of S$5,000 if death occurs during coverage period
policies.eligibility_notes: All ages mentioned refer to age next birthday.
policies.coverage_term_description: Choice of coverage term from 10 years up to age 99 (in one-year intervals).
policy_termination_events: Critical Illness Benefit ceases once 600% of the Sum Assured is fully paid out
Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit ceases once 300% of the Sum Assured is fully paid out or when Advance Care Option is successfully exercised (whichever is earlier)
Advance Care Option exercised successfully (terminates Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit)
Premiums waived after first severe stage diagnosis (no stated termination, but documented as part of benefit mechanics)
important_caveats: The brochure states that full details, definitions, and the complete list of covered illnesses are in the Product Summary.
Waiting periods and survival periods apply (multiple notes reference waiting/survival period applicability).

The Intensive Care Unit (ICU) and other special benefits have additional conditions/cessation rules (e.g., ICU stay must be one hospital admission in Singapore and confirmed as Necessary Medical Treatment; Special Benefit has per-life caps and cessation rules).
All benefit limits stated in Singapore dollars are converted to the equivalent amount in the chosen currency using the insurer’s currency conversion rate when coverage is not in SGD.

benefits.benefit_name: Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit (Severe condition recurrences)
benefits.benefit_description: Provides payout upon diagnosis of certain specified severe stage critical illnesses after the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased, and provides additional payout for their recurrences. Payout is 150% of the sum assured per eligible claim with a maximum of two claims; total payout capped at 300% of sum assured. Waiting periods apply between Recurrent benefit claims.
benefits.trigger_description: Diagnosis of any one of the specified Severe Stage Critical Illnesses after the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased, or diagnosis of any one of the Recurrent Critical Illnesses covered.
covered_conditions: 6 specified severe stage critical illnesses under Recurrent CI (as described in brochure figure/text: “6 specified severe stage critical illnesses”)
Recurrent forms listed as re-diagnosed major cancer and recurrences listed for other conditions (complete list in Product Summary)
benefits.payout_description: 150% of the Sum Assured per eligible recurrent CI claim, subject to claim count and total payout cap.
benefits.claim_frequency: Up to 2 eligible claims (maximum total 300% of the Sum Assured) with waiting period between claims.
benefits.benefit_start_description: Applies after the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased, and continues while eligible until cap or Advance Care Option cessation.
benefits.benefit_expiry_description: Benefit will cease once 300% of the Sum Assured is fully paid out or when Advance Care Option is successfully exercised (whichever is earlier).
benefits.notes: The brochure states a two-year waiting period between two Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit claims.

evidence.quote: Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit pays 150% of the Sum Assured per eligible claim, up to two claims (maximum total 300% of the Sum Assured).

This benefit applies if the Life Assured is diagnosed with: (i) any one of the specified Severe Stage Critical Illnesses covered under this benefit, provided the Critical Illness Benefit has ceased; or (ii) any one of the Recurrent Critical Illnesses covered under this benefit.
The benefit will cease once 300% of the Sum Assured is fully paid out, or when the Advance Care Option is successfully exercised under the Policy, whichever is earlier.
Under the Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit, there is a two-year waiting period between two Recurrent Critical Illness Benefit claims.

source_evidence.quote: Illness1 Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II
With Singlife Multipay Critical Illness II, your protection doesn’t stop at one diagnosis.
Be it early, intermediate or severe stage, you’re covered across 135 conditions with continued protection after diagnosis, backed by multiple payouts.
Get up to 900% of your sum assured with multiple payouts across different critical illnesses.
